message: Mostly good, with minor documentation comments inline.

lustre/utils/liblustreapi.c.message: (minor) Since this changes the contract of the public `llapi_parse_size()` API, could the patch also add an `llapi_parse_size(3)` page and register it in `Documentation/man3/Makefile.am`? The in-source kernel-doc is not installed for liblustreapi consumers.

lustre/utils/lhsmtool_posix.c.message: (minor) Could this spell out the accepted suffixes and the new distinction between `M`/`MiB` and `MB`? This is the copytool's user-facing help, but "unit can be used" does not document that `MB` now selects decimal units.
